diagnostics.pattern: (一次|一次性)(完成|实现|做完)(所有|全部|整个)

message.zh-CN: 一次性完成所有改动的 prompt 难以验证，也难定位失败原因
message.en: A prompt that completes everything at once is hard to verify and hard to debug

hint.zh-CN: 拆成按验证结果推进的小步：每轮一个目标、一个验证命令。
hint.en: Split into small steps driven by verification: one goal and one verification command per round.

diagnostics.pattern: (不需要|无需|不用|跳过)(测试|验证|review|审查)

message.zh-CN: 要求跳过测试或审查的指令不可接受
message.en: Instructions that skip tests or review are not acceptable

hint.zh-CN: 每个改动都必须留下验证证据：测试输出、命令退出码或可复现观察。
hint.en: Every change needs verification evidence: test output, command exit code or reproducible observation.

message.zh-CN: prompt 中疑似包含密钥或令牌明文
message.en: The prompt seems to contain a plaintext key or token

hint.zh-CN: 改用占位符（如 <API_KEY>），真实值只放在环境变量或安全配置中。
hint.en: Use a placeholder such as <API_KEY>; keep real values in environment variables or secure configuration.
